people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: They will know that I am Yahweh when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.
translations.bsb: Then they will know that I am the LORD when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are shattered.
translations.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
